jobs.description:
Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You are a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

If you don't meet every requirement but have some warehouse experience and a strong work ethic, you can still apply!

 

IMPORTANT: this job is only available for people who:

• Already live in Belgium
• Have a valid Belgian address
• Have legal permission to work in Belgium
Housing, relocation and visa sponsorship are not available for this position.

Are you a night owl with a talent for solving technical challenges?

Do you thrive in a modern production environment where teamwork and quality are top priorities? Then this is the opportunity for you!

Your role

As a Maintenance Technician in the fixed night shift, you are essential to our production process. You ensure that machines operate at their best, perform preventive maintenance, and resolve malfunctions quickly and effectively. With your technical skills and problem-solving mindset, you keep the production running even while the world sleeps.

What will you do?

• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations.
• Detect, analyze, and fix malfunctions (primarily electrical, ideally with mechanical expertise).
• Start up and optimize production lines.
• Actively contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of the equipment.
• Collaborate with a team and report to the technical service manager.
Work schedule

• 2 workdays (2 x 7.36 hours) and 2 weekend days (2 x 11 hours), offering a steady yet varied schedule.
 

 

• A technical degree or relevant experience in a production environment.
• Broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics; PLC knowledge is a plus.
• A flexible, positive attitude and strong problem-solving skills.
• A team player who is eager to learn and improve.
• Fluency in Dutch or English.

Are you technically skilled, detail-oriented, and looking for a varied role in a warm, family-owned company? Then this position as Mould Technician could be the perfect fit for you!

In this role, you will be responsible for the correct assembly and disassembly of moulds. Every changeover is carried out with great attention to detail and in line with established procedures, ensuring that all equipment remains in perfect condition. Careful handling and precision are key.

After a thorough onboarding period and once you have gained sufficient experience, you will also be responsible for restarting machines after a changeover. In addition, you will support the mould department with various tasks such as:

• Maintenance and repair of moulds
• Assembling and fine-tuning moulds
• Providing general technical support
• No two days are the same!

• Strong mechanical knowledge is essential
• Able to work very precisely and neatly
• Experience in a similar technical role is an advantage
• Skilled in setting up production machines and tools
• Able to plan efficiently and set priorities, both independently and in a team
• Methodical approach, following procedures with an eye for improvement
• Quick to analyse, report, and adjust when needed
• Positive, constructive attitude
• Good command of English is required, as one colleague communicates exclusively in English

As an operator, together with a colleague, you are responsible for operating and setting up the production line. You use an overhead crane, set the correct parameters and knife distances, and make sure the rolls are properly packaged. Some administrative work on the computer is also part of your job. You work in two fixed shifts: from 5 a.m. to 1 p.m. or from 1 p.m. to 9 p.m.
Every day is varied: setting up machines, performing quality checks, and processing production documentation. You are alert to safety and contribute to a smooth production process.
Does this job appeal to you? Apply now!

• Relevant experience as an operator

• Technical insight and logical thinking

• Good computer skills

• Attention to quality and safety

• Stress-resistant and result-oriented

• Team player

• You speak fluent Dutch or English

Do you enjoy working with a forklift and appreciate order? This forklift operator position allows you to support the entire production process. 

You make sure raw materials and finished products are always in the right place to keep operations running smoothly.Your typical day starts by checking your forklift. You supply the necessary materials according to the production schedule and safely store finished goods in the designated locations.

Does this job sound interesting? Apply quickly and make a difference as a forklift operator!

• You have experience as a forklift operator or in a similar role
• You speak fluent Dutch, English, or French
• You work safely and precisely
• You take initiative to report problems or defects
• You are willing to work in two shifts

As an operator, you work together with your colleagues to operate computer-controlled machines. You set the correct parameters, perform checks, and make sure the production process runs smoothly.
Your day involves setting up machines, performing quality checks, and packaging products. You work in a shift system and actively contribute ideas for improvements.
Interested in joining an innovative team where you can grow? Apply now!

• Preferably, you already have relevant experience in a production environment

• Working in a continuous shift system appeals to you

• You speak fluent Dutch or English

• Motivated and eager to learn

• Team player who takes initiative

As an operator, you work together with your colleagues to operate computer-controlled machines. You set the correct parameters, perform checks, and make sure the production process runs smoothly.
Your day involves setting up machines, performing quality checks, and packaging products. You work in a shift system and actively contribute ideas for improvements.
Interested in joining an innovative team where you can grow? Apply now!

• Preferably, you already have relevant experience in a production environment

• Working in a continuous shift system appeals to you

• You speak fluent Dutch or English

• Motivated and eager to learn

• Team player who takes initiative

As a Welder, you are responsible for welding aluminum profiles with quality and precision. You make sure every profile is processed according to the agreed guidelines, playing an important role in the production of design lighting fixtures.

A typical day includes operating the welding robot or TIG welding machine, preparing and cutting profiles, and setting the rolling machine. Together with your colleagues, you follow up on the order lists to ensure everything is completed accurately and on time. You work with great attention to detail and strive for a neat end result each time.

Are you passionate about technology and enjoy working with your hands? Do you want to be part of a team where you help create unique products? Apply quickly and discover this opportunity!

• Technical background
• Training in metalwork is a plus
• Experience as a welder (aluminum)
• You work accurately and pay attention to detail
• Good knowledge of Dutch or English

Kick-start your career in marketing operations, client services and project coordination!

Are you a recent graduate or have had a positive first work experience in a marketing services environment and looking for a role where you can learn fast, take ownership, work with clients in an international environment, and make a real impact from day one?

Our client is looking for an enthusiastic and driven Program Coordinator to join their Belgian team in Hasselt.

This hybrid role combines client communication, project coordination and related admin (quotations, invoicing), vendor communications, operational coordination and process improvement within a dynamic B2B direct marketing environment focused on print, fulfillment and logistics services.

You'll work closely with experienced colleagues who will support, coach and train you while giving you the opportunity to grow into a trusted client and operations professional. We are looking for someone with common sense, energy, curiosity, and a proactive mindset. Someone

who communicates openly and clearly, takes ownership, and challenges the status quo when a better solution exists. 

A forward thinker who anticipates obstacles, identifies opportunities, and consistently stays one step ahead. Comfortable working independently, making sound decisions, and driving initiatives forward with limited supervision, while also recognizing the value of collaboration and actively contributing to a strong team environment. Someone who thrives on solving problems, improving processes, and turning challenges into opportunities for growth and success.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment, build strong relationships with colleagues and clients, and bring a practical, can-do approach to business challenges. While previous experience in a similar role is an advantage, we place greater value on attitude, drive, pro-activeness, learning agility, and the potential to make a meaningful impact from day one. No two days are the same. One day you might be coordinating a client project, the next day you could be visiting our warehouse partners, analysing operational performance, or identifying opportunities to improve processes and customer experience.

During your first years with our client, you'll gain experience in: 

 
• Client relationship management 
 
• Project coordination 
 
• Marketing operations 
 
• Print and fulfillment services 
 
• Vendor and warehouse coordination 
 
• Business process improvement 
 
• Data analysis and reporting 
 
• Operational excellence 
 
• Cross-functional collaboration

Our client is a global marketing services organization specializing in multi-channel B2B & B2C marketing solutions that connect their clients with their customers in powerful ways. Experts in defining, executing, and optimizing the customer journey, they offer end-to-end marketing services including consulting, strategic assessment, data, analytics, digital, social, mobile, print, fulfillment, logistics and contact center
solutions. 

 

What You Bring: 

 
• Recent Professional Bachelor or Master's graduate 
 
• Looking for a first professional role with growth opportunities 
 
• Native in Dutch, fluent in French and English (verbal and in writing) 
 
• Naturally proactive, eager to take ownership, and driven to deliver results without waiting to be
asked 
 
• Strong pro-active communicator who enjoys working with both colleagues and clients 
 
• Analytical mindset with an eye for detail 
 
• Curious and solution-oriented 
 
• Comfortable challenging existing processes and proposing improvements 
 
• Able to combine structured thinking with practical execution 
 
• Positive attitude and willingness to learn 
 
• Not afraid to roll up your sleeves when needed and take the extra mile to make it happen 
 
• Proficient in Microsoft Office 365 applications

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

As a Truck Driver CE, you are responsible for transporting goods within Belgium, Northern France, and Southern Netherlands. You load and unload the truck yourself with an electric pallet truck and always check your documents and vehicle. You register everything correctly in the onboard computer. Ready to hit the road independently? Apply now!

• You have a CE driving license and a valid professional competence certificate (code 95).

• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Truck Driver CE.

• You speak fluent Dutch or English.

• You can work independently and are accurate with administration.

• You are comfortable with a PC and onboard computer.

• You are willing to work an average of 12 hours per day.

• You live within commuting distance to Hooglede.

jobs.occupation: Store Assistant / Sales Associate – Christmas Shop | Bruges | Full-Time
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a welcoming retail environment and love the magic of Christmas? Do you enjoy helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holiday season?

For a unique Christmas store in the heart of Bruges, we are looking for an enthusiastic Store Assistant / Sales Associate who will help customers bring the Christmas spirit into their homes.

What will you do?
As a Sales Associate, you will be the face of the store and ensure that every customer enjoys a warm and pleasant shopping experience.

Your responsibilities include:

• Welcoming and assisting customers in a friendly manner
• Advising customers on Christmas decorations, ornaments, gifts and seasonal products
• Maintaining an attractive and organized store presentation
• Restocking shelves and keeping the store clean and tidy
• Processing payments and handling cash register duties
• Assisting with deliveries and unpacking new merchandise

• You enjoy working with customers and providing excellent service
• You are willing to work weekends on a rotating schedule
• Previous retail or sales experience is an advantage
• You speak Spanish, Dutch or English fluently
• In addition to your strongest language, you can communicate at a basic level in at least one of the other languages
• You enjoy working in an international environment with tourists and visitors from different countries
• You are enthusiastic, reliable and enjoy working as part of a team

We are looking for packing employees who are available to work in a three-shift system (food industry) in Dendermonde?

If you're interested, read the job description and apply!

You will be working in the packing department of a company that specializes in packaging frozen products. This role involves working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 10°C).

Your main tasks include:

• Checking product quality

• Packing various products (such as fish, snacks, vegetables, etc.) into boxes or bags

• Applying labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Maintaining close communication with the operator

• Other related tasks

What we expect from you:

• You have previous experience in a production environment or are willing to learn, and you can work flexibly in a three-shift system (morning, late and night shift).

• You are comfortable performing physical work at a steady pace.

• You have a good command of Dutch or English to understand safety instructions.

• You can travel independently to Dendermonde each day, as the company is located in an industrial zone and is not accessible by public transport.

• You are looking for long-term employment and are willing to complete a 2-hour packing test after a successful interview.

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.
You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

You will be responsible for the assembly and mounting of products.
You will be trained as a multi-skilled worker and deployed across 8 different workstations.

You are able to work in a two-shift system and can work both independently and as part of a team.
You already have some initial experience in assembly work.
You are punctual and work accurately.
You speak English or Dutch so that you can communicate with colleagues.

Robert Half is looking for a Customer Service Representative (Italian/French/English) (M/F/X) in Zaventem.

Do you have excellent knowledge of Italian, French and English? Are you looking for a permanent position within a dynamic and international team? We are seeking a customer-oriented, detail-focused team player for a growing company in the diplomatic sector.

Your responsibilities:

• Customer contact by phone and email;
• Maintain and update customer files (including specific customs documents);
• Perform daily checks, checklists, and follow up on overdue files;
• Work with proprietary software; fast and comfortable using PC;
• Collaborate with internal colleagues and external partners.

Profile:

• Excellent Italian, French and English required; -
• You must have a bachelor or masters degree.
• You live in Belgium and are eligible to work here.
• You can reach the company easily (Zaventem)
• Accurate and detail-oriented, affinity with administrative processes
• Team player, able to work independently; flexibility is a must
You must meet all requirements to be considered for this position.

jobs.occupation: Join Our Team as an Order Picker Warehouse Associate – Start Immediately in a Dynamic Environment!
jobs.description:
As an order picker warehouse associate, you play a key role in the warehouse operation. You will operate a high-level order picker truck (VNA), allowing you to safely pick products from elevated racks. Using a handheld scanner, you accurately check locations, quantities, and the correctness of orders. Your effort ensures that customers receive the right products on time and keeps the logistics process running smoothly.

On a typical workday, you collect customer orders by picking products from various warehouse locations. You work closely with colleagues, strictly follow safety instructions, and keep your workspace clean. You check products for damage or missing items and report these to the team leader. Packing and preparing orders for shipment is also part of your tasks, ensuring everything is ready to go out to customers efficiently.

Are you physically fit, detail-oriented, and do you enjoy a varied job in logistics? Apply today and make a difference in a close-knit team where collaboration and safety are essential.

• Previous experience as an order picker or warehouse associate is a plus.
• Certificate of good conduct (criminal record certificate) required.
• License or certificate for high-level order picker truck is an advantage.
• English speaking skills at level 3/5 (for effective communication and understanding instructions).
• Good physical fitness: able to stand, walk, and lift up to 17 kg.
• Accurate, responsible, and able to work safely in a fast-paced environment.

What will you be doing?

During the season:

You will be part of a dynamic, energetic team that processes 45 tons of carrots per hour. Together with your colleagues, you will:

• Monitoring the operation of machines (conveyor belts, scanners, cutting and packaging systems)
• Check quality and make changes when necessary
• Show initiative and make quick decisions in difficult situations
• Detecting faults, responding immediately to breakdowns and making quick operational decisions
• Making settings and quality improvements
• Seasonal maintenance, minor repairs, and support for the maintenance department – replacing belts, lubrication, sensor adjustment, filter checks, etc.
• Working in accordance with health and safety and hygiene regulations

Out of season:

You will assist with maintenance and repairs to keep our equipment in top condition. This is not a lab job—you will be working on robust washing and sorting lines, not delicate machines in clean rooms. Practical knowledge and hands-on skills are essential.

• Solid technical knowledge and a proactive approach
• Good command of English allowing for effective communication
• Experience working with loaders or forklifts is a plus
• You enjoy working outdoors and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty
• You are responsible, independent, and solution-oriented
• Flexibility to support other departments during quieter periods
• During the high season (July, August, September), it is not possible to take vacation

Are you ready to take the next step in your career as a Technical Operator? As a vital member of our team, you'll work with cutting-edge machinery to produce high-quality steel profiles. You'll become an expert in operating our state-of-the-art equipment, ensuring that production runs smoothly and efficiently.

Every day, you'll engage with complex and simple finishing machines including conventional and CNC-controlled systems like sawing machines, drilling machines, and laser cutters. Your keen attention to detail and commitment to quality will ensure that every component meets our high standards.

We're looking for motivated and eager-to-learn individuals. Apply now to join a supportive environment where your skills will be valued and developed!

• Technical school diploma or equivalent experience

• Proficiency in reading and executing mechanical diagrams

• Fluency in English

• Knowledge of pneumatics and ability to install tubes and test movements

• Passion for technology and a team-oriented mindset

• Eagerness to learn with a conscientious and responsible approach

• Strict adherence to safety rules and flexibility in working hours

Step into a rewarding role as a Lift Technician where your technical prowess will keep crucial lift systems running smoothly. You’ll be part of a dedicated team responsible for installation, maintenance, and repair services, ensuring safety and reliability. Your daily tasks will include troubleshooting, performing mechanical and electrical maintenance, and collaborating closely with clients and team members to deliver top-notch service. 

An average day will see you working independently on various customer sites, primarily within the province of Antwerp. You'll tackle a range of mechanical and electrical challenges, ensuring each lift is operating safely and efficiently. Your problem-solving skills will be put to good use as you diagnose issues and implement effective solutions.

If you’re ready to elevate your career in a role that offers both challenge and opportunity, apply today! Your journey towards becoming a key player in our technical team starts here.

• Technical school diploma or equivalent experience
• Background in mechanical and/or electrical fields
• Valid Category B driving license
• Strong problem-solving skills
• Ability to work independently and manage your schedule
• Good communication skills in English
• Flexible and responsible attitude
